raw.title: Fivetran : Manager Security Engineer, Operations
raw.description:
Headquarters: Remote, Massachusetts, United States, AMER

From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us


Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran + dbt  is seeking a Manager of Security Operations, Incident Detection and Response, to bolster and improve the robustness and security of the platform and the entire enterprise. This people-leadership role is hands-on and execution-focused, requiring deep expertise in security operations, incident detection and response, AI-driven security automation, and securing multi-tenant SaaS environments. You'll build and lead a high-performing team, own the detection and response technology stack, and serve as the accountable leader for incident response across the entire enterprise, ensuring threats are detected, contained, and remediated quickly from endpoint to cloud to production.

This is a full-time remote position based out of the US (EST Time Zone).

Technologies You’ll Use

Crowdstrike, Okta, Google Workspace, Wiz, Open Source, Notion, JIRA

What You’ll Do

  • People Leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of detection and response engineers and analysts. Set clear goals, manage performance, and grow careers while fostering a culture of ownership, curiosity, and urgency.
  • Hiring & Team Building: Recruit, hire, and onboard top security talent. Define team structure, roles, on-call rotations, and hiring plans to scale the team alongside the business.
  • Enterprise Incident Response: Own the incident response program for the entire enterprise, including investigation, containment, eradication, remediation, and post-incident review. Act as incident commander for major security events and coordinate with Legal, Privacy, Communications, and executive leadership.
  • Detection Engineering: Build, optimize, and maintain high-fidelity detections across cloud, identity, endpoint, SaaS, and application layers, using threat-informed approaches such as MITRE ATT&CK to close coverage gaps.
  • AI-Driven Security Operations: Drive the adoption of AI, including LLMs and AI agents, to automate alert triage, enrichment, investigation, and response. Evaluate and integrate AI capabilities to scale the team, and build detections for threats targeting AI systems and AI usage across the enterprise.
  • Multi-Tenant SaaS Security: Design detection and response strategies tailored to a multi-tenant SaaS platform, including tenant isolation, cross-tenant access, and customer data protection. Lead customer-impacting incident response and coordinate customer notifications.
  • Security Technology Ownership: Own the security operations technology stack, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, cloud detection and response, and log pipelines. Manage the roadmap, budget, and vendor relationships.
  • Threat Hunting & Intelligence: Lead proactive threat hunting and integrate threat intelligence to identify and mitigate emerging threats before they impact the business.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work directly with engineering, infrastructure, IT, application security, and GRC teams to integrate detection and response practices and remediate risks across build pipelines, runtime environments, and corporate systems.
  • Tooling & Automation: Develop and maintain automation, playbooks, and integrations to streamline security processes and provide self-service security tools to the organization.
  • Security Standards & Metrics: Implement consistent security controls, monitoring, and alerting across the enterprise. Define and report on key metrics such as mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to respond (MTTR), and support compliance requirements.
  • Knowledge Sharing: Stay up to date with trends in security operations, incident response, cloud security, and AI security, applying this knowledge to improve the Fivetran platform's security posture.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • Security Operations & Incident Response Expertise: Deep expertise in detecting, investigating, and responding to security incidents, with a track record of leading enterprise-wide incident response.
  • People Management: Proven experience managing, hiring, and developing security teams, including setting priorities, managing performance, and building a strong team culture.
  • Multi-Tenant SaaS Experience: Extensive experience securing and responding to incidents in multi-tenant SaaS environments at scale, with a strong understanding of tenant isolation and customer data protection.
  • AI Proficiency: Hands-on experience applying AI, including LLMs and AI agents, to security operations to automate detection, triage, and response, and a strong understanding of the risks AI introduces.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure Security: Strong experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure), Kubernetes, and containerized environments, including cloud-native logging and detection.
  • Detection & Response Tooling: Proficiency with SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, identity, and cloud detection tools, and experience integrating them into automated workflows.
  • Technology Ownership: Experience owning a security technology roadmap, including tool selection, budgets, and vendor management.
  • Problem-Solving: Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to make sound decisions under pressure in fast-paced environments.
  • Communication: Strong communication skills with the ability to effectively collaborate with and educate engineering teams, and to communicate clearly with executives and customers during incidents.
  • Curiosity & Urgency: Demonstrates strong curiosity, a sense of urgency, and a hands-on approach to diving deep into complex technical problems to drive timely and effective solutions.

The compensation range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your location during the hiring process.

Pay Range
$186,701—$233,376 USD

 

Perks and Benefits

  • 100% employer-paid medical insurance*
  • Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
  • RSU stock grants*

Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

title: Senior Platform Security Engineer
description: Headquarters: Remote (California, Washington, and Oregon Only) Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games. More broadly, Discord is about empowering people to find belonging in all kinds of communities, and those people trust us to keep their communications safe. Our Platform Security Engineering team protects the systems we use to create Discord, making the "secure way" the "easy way." We're looking for a Senior Engineer to advance this mission through security expertise, software development, and operational excellence, with a particular focus on identity and access management: who and what can access Discord's systems, how they authenticate, and how access stays scoped to what's actually needed. You'll help identify leveraged opportunities to reduce security risk across Engineering, then design and deliver technical solutions: lovable "paved paths" for managing identities and access, shipping code, configuring cloud infrastructure, and operating services. If you're a security engineer with a deep interest in identity and access management, who's eager to own technically and socially complex projects, and excited to improve security and privacy at Discord, read on! This position can be based in California, Washington, or Oregon. For those within 50 miles of our San Francisco office, the Hiring Manager would like folks to be in the office 1-2 days a week. What you'll do Own software engineering projects end-to-end on a highly autonomous, horizontally integrated team with a lot of leverage. This is a code-forward role! Define what identity means for autonomous agents and other non-human actors at Discord (how they're provisioned, scoped, authenticated, authorized, and audited). As the role of these actors grows, and create primitives to implement that vision. Build and evolve Access , Discord's employee authorization platform, to make permissions discoverable, role-based, least privilege, and self-serve; check out our blog post to learn more! Design and harden our Zero Trust architecture, spanning human and service-to-service auth*n for Discord’s internal tooling. Automate continuous permission right-sizing in the spirit of least privilege. Develop and apply secure baselines for cloud identity, and help secure our software supply chain from the dev environment through CI/CD and into production. Consult on risk assessments, architectural designs, threat models, code reviews, and more, pragmatically balancing security with other business considerations. Example projects Integrate service-to-service and agent-to-service authentication and authorization as out-of-the-box features in Discord's internal developer platform. Build out service identity provisioning using PKI and mTLS, so services can authenticate each other without shared secrets. raw.title: Dropbox: Application Security Engineer
raw.description:
Headquarters: Remote - US: Select locations

Role Description

As part of the Product Security Engineering team, you’ll focus on reducing risk at scale by building the security infrastructure, automation, and tooling that empowers engineers to ship secure products with confidence. We work closely with engineering and product teams throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), embedding secure-by-default practices and delivering scalable solutions.

Product Security Engineers create impact by implementing security tooling, writing custom security rules, and building frameworks that address broad classes of vulnerabilities. In addition to proactive development, we support teams through threat modeling, documentation, and education to uplift security culture across Dropbox.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain security tools, automation, and libraries to enable secure-by-default development across engineering teams.
  • Design and implement custom security rules (e.g., Semgrep, CodeQL) to detect and prevent common and emerging vulnerability patterns.
  • Act as a subject matter expert on application security across web, mobile, and desktop environments.
  • Improve and scale the Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC) by integrating tools, checks, and processes into engineering workflows.
  • Perform targeted code reviews, and develop follow-up tooling or controls to prevent regressions.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, GRC, and AI/ML teams to proactively address security risks, especially in fast-moving and emerging tech areas.

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in application security or security engineering roles.
  • Hands-on experience building or using security automation tools to improve developer workflows and product security.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across the SDLC, including supporting and interpreting findings from penetration tests and bug bounty reports.
  • Familiarity with modern tech stacks, including microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native environments.
  • Solid understanding of common vulnerability classes (e.g., injection, XSS, authN/authZ issues) and practical mitigation strategies.
  • Comfortable working in cross-functional environments and supporting multiple product and engineering teams simultaneously.
  • Experience participating in or supporting incident response or security on-call rotations is a plus

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in application security engineering, with a strong focus on security tooling and automation.
  • Demonstrated ability to write and maintain custom security rules and integrate them into developer workflows.
  • Experience with machine learning systems, particularly generative AI, and the ability to support secure development in AI-driven products.
  • Experience developing internal libraries or frameworks that reduce or eliminate entire classes of vulnerabilities.
  • Proficient in software development, with experience contributing production-level code in one or more modern languages.
  • Familiarity with securing diverse application types, including web, mobile, and native platforms.
  • Experience with data security, including tooling for data protection, access control, and encryption.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to build trusted partnerships with cross-functional teams.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

US Zone 1

This role is not available in Zone 1

US Zone 2
$193,500—$261,900 USD
US Zone 3
$172,000—$232,800 USD

Headquarters: New York, New York; Miami, Florida; Remote (USA)

About the Company

Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering a wide range of simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. Our mission is to unlock the next era of financial, creative, and personal freedom by providing trusted access to the decentralized future. We envision a world where crypto reshapes the global financial system, internet, and money to create greater choice, independence, and opportunity for all — bridging traditional finance with the emerging cryptoeconomy in a way that is more open, fair, and secure. As a publicly traded company, Gemini is poised to accelerate this vision with greater scale, reach, and impact.

The Department: Platform Security

In the emerging industry of digital assets, there is nothing more important than trust. The Gemini security team forms the backbone of trust. In fact, Gemini’s very first hires were security specialists and we continue to tackle unique challenges in the crypto space.  Our team ensures that our customers, clients, and employees are safe, secure, and supported.

The Role: Senior Manager, Platform Security

Gemini takes a cloud-first approach to our services, platforms, and vendors, allowing the organization to continue scaling with hypergrowth hiring, innovative product development, and demanding customer needs. To achieve that scale securely, Gemini has a dedicated Platform Security team whose mission is to enable the business to achieve secure-by-design architectures, implement best-in-class security technologies, and help our engineering partners to achieve security success easily & confidently. To further that mission, we’re looking for a new leader to join the existing team to take our vision, strategy, internal partnerships, business alignment, & technical expertise to the next stage of maturity. At Gemini, our best leaders lead from the trenches — we need this Senior Manager to remain hands-on, spending a meaningful portion of their time in the code, IaC, and architecture diagrams alongside their team — writing Terraform, reviewing PRs, and prototyping solutions, not just unblocking others when they're stuck.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide strategic and technical leadership of Gemini's Platform Security team, personally architecting and implementing security solutions alongside engineers — including writing and reviewing Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, and security tooling code
  • Align team-wide strategy with the needs of the business, internal partners, & peer Security leadership
  • Enable the ongoing success & growth of the team through creation of hiring plans and hands-on technical mentorship — pairing with engineers, reviewing designs and PRs, and staying current on the team's actual codebase
  • Establish a Platform Security roadmap for initiatives that will provide ever-increasing maturity of capabilities for stakeholders, while also reducing toil through automation
  • Serve as a senior technical escalation point for the team's hardest architecture and engineering problems, contributing working code/IaC when the situation calls for it
  • Foster trust-centric relationships with key partner teams, ensuring that their voices are heard and needs are being met, while achieving excellent security outcomes together
  • Lead the development of security policies, procedures, standards, & guidelines that will guide functional security outcomes with all GRC and Audits needs being met
  • Determine program KPIs that will meaningfully highlight where we’re succeeding, or falling short of, the mission we aim to accomplish for the business
  • Provide guidance through lived-experience and industry awareness on the different approaches to architecture, security engineering, and business-achievement goals
  • Define a customer-first process, choosing to provide self-service solutions that minimize friction, create agility, and provide value-oriented ways to solve problems
  • Manage relevant third-party vendor relationships, leading the determination of when & why to “build” vs. “buy” in response to gaps in capabilities the business may have

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of leadership experience for cloud-native engineering and/or security teams, with a strong preference for Amazon Web Services (AWS)-based organizations
  • 10+ years of direct, technical experience in relevant roles (e.g., Platform Engineering, Security), with continued hands-on coding/IaC work within the last 2-3 years — not solely past practitioner experience
  • Strong experience in AWS, EKS (Kubernetes), IAM, Terraform, GitHub Enterprise Cloud
  • Experience leveraging industry security frameworks & standards that act as the basis of maturing the overall security program and enable successful business outcomes
  • Comfortable with hiring & scaling a team 
  • Prior success in leading a team through organizational change management, with a strong preference for start-up experience in a technology-centric business
  • Able to easily communicate with technical stakeholders at their level, hearing their feedback and translating those needs or concerns into program-level outcomes
  • Pragmatic about security requirements, ignoring “best practices” that don’t make sense to the needs of the business by leveraging your team’s expertise for decision making
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with an attention to detail
It Pays to Work Here
 
The compensation & benefits package for this role includes:
  • Competitive starting pay
  • A discretionary annual bonus
  • Long-term incentive in the form of a new hire equity grant
  • Comprehensive health plans
  • 401K with company matching
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Flexible time off

Salary Range: The base salary range for this role is between $195,000 - $300,000 in the State of New York. This range is not inclusive of our discretionary bonus or equity package. When determining a candidate’s compensation, we consider a number of factors including skillset, experience, job scope, and current market data.

In the United States, we offer a hybrid work approach at our hub offices, balancing the benefits of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Expectations may vary by location and role, so candidates are encouraged to connect with their recruiter to learn more about the specific policy for the role. Employees who do not live near one of our hubs are part of our remote workforce. All employees, however, are required to onboard in-person at one of our office locations.

At Gemini, we strive to build diverse teams that reflect the people we want to empower through our products, and we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. Equal Opportunity is the Law, and Gemini is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. If you have a specific need that requires accommodation, please let a member of the People Team know.

description: Headquarters: Canada (Remote) Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B. We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal.  We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people. About the Role: We are looking for a highly technical, hands-on Principal DevSecOps Developer to join Upgrade's Security team. In this role, you'll focus on building and improving security automation, strengthening our SaaS environment, and developing scalable solutions that enhance security operations across the organization. You'll leverage your programming and scripting skills, hands-on operations experience, and understanding of APIs, IAM permissions, and security best practices to solve complex technical challenges. You'll analyze code, troubleshoot technical issues, and apply risk-based thinking to identify vulnerabilities and implement effective security controls. This is a highly autonomous, engineering-focused role where you'll have the opportunity to build security automations from the ground up, leverage AI to improve workflows, and solve challenging security problems. You'll work closely with Security, Engineering, DevOps, and IT teams to streamline processes. Our Core Technologies: AWS (IAM, Security Services), Terraform, Python, Bash, REST APIs, AI/LLM Tools (Claude, AI Agents, MCP), Tines/SOAR, Sumo Logic, CrowdStrike, Okta, Akamai, Sublime Security, SIGMA/YARA, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD Pipelines, FleetDM/osquery, GCP, Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365. What You’ll Do: Build and maintain security automation workflows to reduce manual processes. Develop and manage infrastructure as code using Terraform. Implement AWS security controls, including IAM policies and least-privilege access. Build secure integrations between systems using APIs and scripting. Identify, investigate, and resolve security risks across cloud infrastructure and internal systems. Use AI tools, agents, and MCP integrations to improve security workflows. Troubleshoot issues across infrastructure, networking, and security tools. Develop and improve security monitoring, detection, and response capabilities. Partner with Engineering, DevOps, and IT teams to implement security improvements. Proactively identify opportunities to strengthen security and automate processes.   What We Look For: Strong programming, scripting, and automation skills across one or more  languages. Hands-on AWS security experience, including IAM permissions and least-privilege principles. Strong Terraform skills, including independently writing and maintaining modules. Solid understanding of APIs, authentication, and secure integrations. Knowledge of security fundamentals, risk analysis, and cloud security best practices. Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, networking, and technical operations. Experience using AI development tools while independently validating generated code. Familiarity with AI agents, automation frameworks, or MCP integrations. Ability to work independently and solve complex technical problems. Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.   Nice to Have: Experience with Tines or other SOAR platforms. Familiarity with CrowdStrike, Okta, Akamai, or Sublime Security. Experience with Sumo Logic or similar monitoring tools. Experience writing SIGMA or YARA detection rules. Understanding of event-driven architecture and enterprise IT systems. Experience with Kubernetes and container security. Knowledge of OWASP principles, including LLM/AI security. Experience with FleetDM, osquery, or endpoint security tools. Familiarity with GCP, Google Workspace, or Microsoft Entra ID. Experience with CI/CD pipeline security or software supply chain security. Threat hunting or security investigation experience. Exposure to security compliance frameworks.   What Will Make You Successful: You take ownership and work independently with minimal direction. You identify problems and proactively develop solutions. You are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn new technologies. You use AI effectively without relying on it for every task, and are able to leverage your own knowledge and experience to challenge its assertions. You communicate openly and collaborate well across teams. You enjoy improving processes and making a measurable impact.   What We Offer You:  Competitive salary ($170k-$240k) and stock option plan Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance  Flexible PTO Opportunities for professional growth and development  Paid parental leave Health & wellness initiatives Environmental & Working Conditions Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations. Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives. The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need. Job duties may involve managing a high volume of inbound and/or outbound customer interactions and work activities using telecommunications and computer systems. The role requires the ability to read, analyze, and interpret information displayed on computer screens and remain in a working posture for extended periods, consistent with the demands of the position. Work may be performed in a contact center, office, or remote environment, depending on business needs and the nature of the role. Onsite work environments may include shared workspaces, standard office lighting, and moderate background noise typical of customer service or operational settings. Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information. title: Competitive Intelligence Strategist
description: Headquarters: Remote Ireland   What We Do: Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact. Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection. Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.   Reports to: Senior Manager, Competitive Intelligence Compensation Range: €77,500 to €87,500 base plus bonus and equity Location: Remote Ireland What You’ll Do:  Huntress helps protect organizations from cyber threats with a security platform backed by human expertise. The Competitive & Market Intelligence team helps the business understand how buyers make decisions, how competitors and market conditions are changing, and what those changes mean for Huntress. As the Senior Competitive & Market Intelligence Strategist, you’ll develop deep insight into European buyers, markets, and competitive dynamics while contributing to global CI and MI priorities. You’ll lead research that informs decisions across regions and turn it into practical guidance for Sales, Product, Product Marketing, Marketing, Pricing, and leadership. The role combines strategic research with field engagement, including deal reviews and support for teams across Huntress. Responsibilities:   Lead Europe-focused market and competitive research while contributing to global CMI priorities. Analyze buyer priorities, category and channel dynamics, competitor positioning, pricing and packaging, and differences across regions. Design and conduct primary and secondary research, including buyer, customer, and partner conversations; win/loss research; competitor analysis; review and community research; and quantitative analysis. Triangulate evidence rather than relying on a single source. Investigate market requirements and differences across regions, with particular depth in European cybersecurity frameworks, regulation, data residency, sovereignty, procurement, and cross-border data access. Build working knowledge of these topics; deep regulatory expertise is not a prerequisite. Support Sales and Sales Engineering with timely competitive guidance across the global field, with Europe as the primary regional focus. Join relevant deal reviews, support active opportunities, and establish recurring CI office hours and team learning sessions. Build practical discovery questions, objection handling, talk tracks, and competitive content sellers can use. Analyze wins, losses, and delayed purchases across regions using buyer interviews and internal evidence, including Salesforce, Gong, and Clozd; while also conduction your own interviews and surveys to distinguish buyer-validated findings from seller-entered data, signals, and inference. Partner with Product Marketing to establish and evolve competitive positioning strategy and messaging, grounded in buyer and market evidence. Headquarters: Remote Ireland

 

What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

 

Reports to: Senior Manager, Competitive Intelligence

Compensation Range: €77,500 to €87,500 base plus bonus and equity

Location: Remote Ireland

What You’ll Do: 

Huntress helps protect organizations from cyber threats with a security platform backed by human expertise. The Competitive & Market Intelligence team helps the business understand how buyers make decisions, how competitors and market conditions are changing, and what those changes mean for Huntress.

As the Senior Competitive & Market Intelligence Strategist, you’ll develop deep insight into European buyers, markets, and competitive dynamics while contributing to global CI and MI priorities. You’ll lead research that informs decisions across regions and turn it into practical guidance for Sales, Product, Product Marketing, Marketing, Pricing, and leadership. The role combines strategic research with field engagement, including deal reviews and support for teams across Huntress.

Responsibilities:  

  • Lead Europe-focused market and competitive research while contributing to global CMI priorities. Analyze buyer priorities, category and channel dynamics, competitor positioning, pricing and packaging, and differences across regions.

  • Investigate market requirements and differences across regions, with particular depth in European cybersecurity frameworks, regulation, data residency, sovereignty, procurement, and cross-border data access. Build working knowledge of these topics; deep regulatory expertise is not a prerequisite.
  • Support Sales and Sales Engineering with timely competitive guidance across the global field, with Europe as the primary regional focus. Join relevant deal reviews, support active opportunities, and establish recurring CI office hours and team learning sessions. Build practical discovery questions, objection handling, talk tracks, and competitive content sellers can use.
  • Analyze wins, losses, and delayed purchases across regions using buyer interviews and internal evidence, including Salesforce, Gong, and Clozd; while also conduction your own interviews and surveys to distinguish buyer-validated findings from seller-entered data, signals, and inference.
  • Partner with Product Marketing to establish and evolve competitive positioning strategy and messaging, grounded in buyer and market evidence. Turn that strategy into battlecards, competitor comparisons, campaign input, market landscapes, and recommendations for global Sales, Product, Marketing, Pricing, and leadership teams.

Use AI tools to accelerate research synthesis and repeatable analysis workflows while validating outputs, protecting sensitive information, and keeping evidence traceable.

What You Bring To The Team:  

  • 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with a background in competitive or market intelligence, market research, Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, or a customer-facing sales role who is research-minded in cybersecurity. One who is detail-oriented and curious is a strong fit.

  • Experience designing and conducting qualitative and quantitative research, analyzing buyer or market evidence, and turning findings into defensible recommendations.
  • Experience researching European markets, or a track record of adapting research to meaningful differences across countries, buyer contexts, and routes to market.
  • The judgment to assess source quality, separate fact from interpretation, and explain what the evidence does and does not support.
  • A track record of translating complex research into concise, useful outputs and presenting findings to commercial, product, marketing, and senior audiences.
  • Experience supporting PR or analyst relations, or serving as a spokesperson, is a plus—not a requirement. Familiarity with relevant European frameworks or regulations is also helpful, not required.

title: Staff DevOps Engineer
description: Headquarters: Czechia URL: http://bloomreach.com Bloomreach is building the world’s premier  agentic platform for personalization .We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the  entire  customer journey. We're taking  autonomous search  mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses. We’re making  conversational shopping  a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey. We're designing the future of  autonomous marketing , taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do. And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine —  Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora. Are you looking for a cutting-edge tech stack to work with daily? We are currently expanding our Infrastructure team  and are looking for a new colleague to join as a Staff DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer . You can work from home or one of our Central Europe offices (Bratislava, Brno, Prague) on a full-time basis. The base salary range for this position is 1 520 000 - 1 900 000 CZK. The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above. Are you ready to grow with us? What tech stack do we have for you? Kubernetes (GKE), Terraform, GitLab Google Cloud, including a wide range of managed products such as Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Bigtable, Dataflow, and Pub/Sub Self-hosted stack: MongoDB, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Etcd, Victoria Metrics, InfluxDB, Sentry Python, Golang Minimum requirements: At least 5 years of production experience with: Kubernetes - we are looking for an engineer who not only deploys applications to a cluster, but also understands what is happening behind the scenes and can operate 24x7 production GCP (preferred)/AWS/Azure - our solution is built on top of the GCP platform. Candidate should be comfortable working with public cloud, understand the risks and benefits associated with running applications in the public cloud, be familiar with infrastructure as a code principle, and have the ability to make design choices between using cloud-managed solutions versus self-hosted alternatives Python/Go - you should be able to read and understand code with confidence, and to review and evaluate AI-generated Python code for correctness, security, and fit. Hands-on coding skills matter less than before, but you should still be able to develop custom tooling when needed, with or without AI assistance   If you don’t meet these requirements, don’t worry; take a look at the Senior DevOps position - Czechia: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/bloomreach/jobs/8329244 , Slovakia: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/bloomreach/jobs/8329243   How to know if you are a good fit: The qualifications outlined below serve as a guide to determine if your skills and experience align with the requirements of this position: Design and Specification : You turn loosely defined problems into designs and specifications that others can execute. You write design proposals, weigh trade-offs between managed and self-hosted solutions, and review the designs of others. Cross-team Leadership : You have led projects spanning multiple teams, from scoping and planning through delivery, coordinating engineers who do not report to you. Independent Delivery : You take a specified maintenance or project task and drive it to completion on your own. AI assistants are a given part of your toolkit, but you always understand and can explain how and why every change was made. AI as a Tool, Not a Replacement : You use AI assistants to work faster, not to hand your work over. You understand what the AI produced, question and verify it, and steer it toward the outcome you want rather than accepting whatever it gives you. You stay in control and remain accountable for everything you ship. Continuous Learning : You have a keen interest in Kubernetes and related technologies, as demonstrated by your active engagement in reading and staying up to date on them. Conference Participation : You have participated in DevOps-related conferences, showcasing your commitment to continuous learning and networking in the field. Configuration Proficiency : You have hands-on experience configuring pod/container security context, network policies, roles and role bindings, pod affinity, host path, pod disruption budgets, priority classes, node taints, to name a few. Resource Optimization : You have analyzed resource usage of applications hosted on a cluster and implemented or suggested changes to resource requests/limits, Horizontal Pod Autoscalers (HPAs), or Vertical Pod Autoscalers (VPAs). Cluster Management : You have a deep understanding of the clusters you manage, including the types of machines used in node pools, the reasons for their selection, which cluster features are enabled or disabled, the cluster version, and the node autoscaling configuration. You have successfully upgraded the Kubernetes cluster versions without interrupting live applications hosted on the cluster. Terraform Proficiency : You have written a Terraform module with multiple interconnected resources. Monitoring and Alerting : You have experience setting up monitoring systems and configuring alerts. On-duty experience is preferred, along with experience with Grafana and Prometheus. DevOps and CI/CD Experience : You have experience with DevOps, Orchestration/Configuration Management, and Continuous Integration technologies, including Terraform, GitLab, Ansible, and Docker. Team Onboarding and Training : You have experience with onboarding and training new team members, demonstrating your leadership skills and commitment to team growth. About your team: The Infrastructure team operates and maintains Bloomreach Engagement core infrastructure built on Google Cloud with security, high availability, costs, and scalability in mind.   Our vision is to identify and implement opportunities to achieve a robust, reliable, and efficient infrastructure and development platform. We strongly support DevOps culture: each team is responsible for releasing, operating, and monitoring their own applications. The role  of the Infrastructure Team is to provide a strong foundation upon which all teams can build, for example, manage big infrastructure components like Kubernetes, databases, and cloud components in Google Cloud. An important role of the team is also to provide support to developers, review design proposals, validate the performance and availability of applications, and sometimes even develop new core application components such as logging or authorization. Tasks and responsibilities: In the position of Staff DevOps Engineer, you’d be expected to work with other Engineering teams to design sustainable infrastructure, microservice solutions, and an efficient and robust production environment. Additionally, you’ll be working on a variety of tasks and projects, including automating tools and infrastructure to reduce manual work, monitoring applications and participating in an on-call rotation as required. You’ll own the design and specification of infrastructure initiatives, break them down into tasks the team can execute, and lead projects that span multiple engineering teams. AI assistants are a given part of your toolkit, and you retain full understanding of, and responsibility for, what gets shipped. The ideal candidate will be passionate about learning new things, creative, willing to take the initiative, and able to think outside the box to solve problems strategically. #LI-KP1 More things you'll like about Bloomreach: Culture: A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. title: Cloud Engineer
description: Headquarters: US URL: https://knack.com Location: US Based (Full-Time, Remote) or International Contractor (Full-Time, Remote) If US-Based: This will be a remote position based in the United States. Knack offers a complete benefits package to those working in the United States. Employees must be available during standard US business hours and maintain their primary work location within the US. Any extended time working outside the United States requires prior written approval. International Contractor: This is a full-time, remote position, but candidates must have four hours overlap with Eastern timezone. Role Overview Knack runs thousands of customer applications across multiple global regions, including dedicated private environments. As a Cloud Engineer, you’ll own and evolve that infrastructure, harden it to meet SOC 2, HIPAA, and customer security requirements, and build the infrastructure behind our growing AI capabilities. We’re an AI-forward team. You don’t need to type every Terraform block, but you do need to understand what’s happening, direct AI tools well, verify their work, and own the outcome. This role includes a weekly 24/7 on-call rotation. About Knack Knack is an AI-powered no-code software development platform enabling organizations to manage, analyze, and share business data. The no-code market is growing at over 30% annually and projected to be almost $200B by 2030. Founded in 2010, Knack has grown into a leading player in the no-code movement, enabling businesses, teams, and individuals to build custom applications without writing a single line of code. Serving a wide range of industries, from healthcare and education to finance and nonprofits, and organizations from small businesses to Fortune 500s, Knack enables users to boost data visibility and streamline operations. To date, the platform has powered 400,000 apps and stored more than 5 billion data records for over 15,000 customers. Its enterprise-grade functionality includes an AI-powered visual builder, robust data structures, user access controls, and automation capabilities, all delivered by a fully remote team committed to trust, continuous improvement, and measurable impact.   Key Responsibilities Run AWS infrastructure as code, with AI in the loop Manage AWS infrastructure through Terraform using our pull-request-based GitOps workflow, and resolve configuration drift across regions. Use AI tools to draft, review, and explain Terraform changes, then verify every plan before it merges. You own every change you approve, regardless of who or what wrote it. Maintain reusable modules and the standards that make AI-generated changes safe and consistent. Make AWS and Claude work together Help design and operate how AI assistants work with our AWS environments, for investigation, analysis, incident triage, and infrastructure changes. Define the IAM roles, permission boundaries, logging, and approval gates that govern what AI tools can see and do. Evaluate AI access for blast radius and auditability. Implement security controls with our security lead Enforce encryption at rest and TLS in transit, tighten IAM and S3 permissions, manage WAF rules and security headers, and rotate secrets. Drive pentest and audit findings to verified fixes in every environment. Secure the AI tooling itself, including agent credentials, secrets handling, MCP server exposure, and prompt injection risk. Support compliance and audits Configure and maintain SOC 2 and HIPAA controls such as log retention, alarms, VPC flow logs, and backups. Ensure AI-assisted changes keep the same review, approval, and audit trail as any other change. Gather audit evidence and help maintain security tooling. Build monitoring, alerting, and runbooks Create dashboards and monitors that catch issues before customers do, and tune noisy alerts. Keep runbooks current and written so that both people and AI assistants can follow them. Keep systems patched and current Lead OS upgrades, runtime and end-of-life migrations, dependency updates, and certificate renewals. Operate and scale databases and customer environments Tune, resize, and secure databases on multiple platforms. Provision or decommission dedicated customer servers for Sales and Support. Resolve escalations and automate repeat work Troubleshoot production issues for Support, Sales, and Engineering. Replace recurring manual tasks with automation, CI/CD improvements, or self-service tooling, using AI to move faster while verifying what it produces. Participate in on-call Participate in our weekly 24/7 on-call rotation, responding to production alerts and following up with fixes or runbook updates so the same issue does not repeat. Qualifications Experience 3-5 years in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, including 2+ years working in AWS production environments. Looking for someone who has experience shipping infrastructure changes through code review. Depth matters more than the number. Experience operating a multi-tenant SaaS platform at scale, including participating in a 24/7 on-call rotation. A degree is not required. Demonstrated hands-on experience counts equally. Technical depth Deep AWS knowledge across compute, networking, and security services, such as EC2, ECS/Fargate, Lambda, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudFront, and RDS. Strong Terraform understanding, including module design, state management, and pull-request-based CI/CD workflows. You can read a plan and explain what will be created, changed, or destroyed, and where the risk is. Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals: least-privilege IAM, encryption in transit and at rest, network security groups and WAFs, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation. Hands-on experience with monitoring and logging tools and building actionable alerts. Experience administering relational and NoSQL databases in production. Solid Linux and container (Docker) fundamentals. Able to read and reason about code and scripts in Python, Go, Bash, or Node.js/TypeScript, including large JavaScript/TypeScript codebases when tracing infrastructure-related bugs. raw.title: Knack: Cloud Engineer
raw.description:
Headquarters: US
URL: https://knack.com

Location: US Based (Full-Time, Remote) or International Contractor (Full-Time, Remote)

If US-Based:
This will be a remote position based in the United States. Knack offers a complete benefits package to those working in the United States. Employees must be available during standard US business hours and maintain their primary work location within the US. Any extended time working outside the United States requires prior written approval.

International Contractor:
This is a full-time, remote position, but candidates must have four hours overlap with Eastern timezone.

Role Overview

Knack runs thousands of customer applications across multiple global regions, including dedicated private environments. As a Cloud Engineer, you’ll own and evolve that infrastructure, harden it to meet SOC 2, HIPAA, and customer security requirements, and build the infrastructure behind our growing AI capabilities.

We’re an AI-forward team. You don’t need to type every Terraform block, but you do need to understand what’s happening, direct AI tools well, verify their work, and own the outcome. This role includes a weekly 24/7 on-call rotation.

About Knack

Knack is an AI-powered no-code software development platform enabling organizations to manage, analyze, and share business data. The no-code market is growing at over 30% annually and projected to be almost $200B by 2030. Founded in 2010, Knack has grown into a leading player in the no-code movement, enabling businesses, teams, and individuals to build custom applications without writing a single line of code.

Serving a wide range of industries, from healthcare and education to finance and nonprofits, and organizations from small businesses to Fortune 500s, Knack enables users to boost data visibility and streamline operations.

To date, the platform has powered 400,000 apps and stored more than 5 billion data records for over 15,000 customers. Its enterprise-grade functionality includes an AI-powered visual builder, robust data structures, user access controls, and automation capabilities, all delivered by a fully remote team committed to trust, continuous improvement, and measurable impact.

 

Key Responsibilities

Run AWS infrastructure as code, with AI in the loop

  • Manage AWS infrastructure through Terraform using our pull-request-based GitOps workflow, and resolve configuration drift across regions.
  • Use AI tools to draft, review, and explain Terraform changes, then verify every plan before it merges. You own every change you approve, regardless of who or what wrote it.
  • Maintain reusable modules and the standards that make AI-generated changes safe and consistent.

Make AWS and Claude work together

  • Help design and operate how AI assistants work with our AWS environments, for investigation, analysis, incident triage, and infrastructure changes.
  • Define the IAM roles, permission boundaries, logging, and approval gates that govern what AI tools can see and do.
  • Evaluate AI access for blast radius and auditability.

Implement security controls with our security lead

  • Enforce encryption at rest and TLS in transit, tighten IAM and S3 permissions, manage WAF rules and security headers, and rotate secrets.
  • Drive pentest and audit findings to verified fixes in every environment.
  • Secure the AI tooling itself, including agent credentials, secrets handling, MCP server exposure, and prompt injection risk.

Support compliance and audits

  • Configure and maintain SOC 2 and HIPAA controls such as log retention, alarms, VPC flow logs, and backups.
  • Ensure AI-assisted changes keep the same review, approval, and audit trail as any other change.
  • Gather audit evidence and help maintain security tooling.

Build monitoring, alerting, and runbooks

  • Create dashboards and monitors that catch issues before customers do, and tune noisy alerts.
  • Keep runbooks current and written so that both people and AI assistants can follow them.

Keep systems patched and current

  • Lead OS upgrades, runtime and end-of-life migrations, dependency updates, and certificate renewals.

Operate and scale databases and customer environments

  • Tune, resize, and secure databases on multiple platforms.
  • Provision or decommission dedicated customer servers for Sales and Support.

Resolve escalations and automate repeat work

  • Troubleshoot production issues for Support, Sales, and Engineering.
  • Replace recurring manual tasks with automation, CI/CD improvements, or self-service tooling, using AI to move faster while verifying what it produces.

Participate in on-call

  • Participate in our weekly 24/7 on-call rotation, responding to production alerts and following up with fixes or runbook updates so the same issue does not repeat.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 3-5 years in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, including 2+ years working in AWS production environments. Looking for someone who has experience shipping infrastructure changes through code review. Depth matters more than the number.
  • Experience operating a multi-tenant SaaS platform at scale, including participating in a 24/7 on-call rotation.
  • A degree is not required. Demonstrated hands-on experience counts equally.

Technical depth

  • Deep AWS knowledge across compute, networking, and security services, such as EC2, ECS/Fargate, Lambda, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudFront, and RDS.
  • Strong Terraform understanding, including module design, state management, and pull-request-based CI/CD workflows. You can read a plan and explain what will be created, changed, or destroyed, and where the risk is.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals: least-privilege IAM, encryption in transit and at rest, network security groups and WAFs, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and logging tools and building actionable alerts.
  • Experience administering relational and NoSQL databases in production.
  • Solid Linux and container (Docker) fundamentals.
  • Able to read and reason about code and scripts in Python, Go, Bash, or Node.js/TypeScript, including large JavaScript/TypeScript codebases when tracing infrastructure-related bugs. You do not need to write them from scratch.

How you work with AI

  • Daily, practical use of AI tools like Claude, with the judgment to critically review AI-generated scripts, Terraform, and IAM policies, and accountability for everything you ship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, or ISO 27001, including evidence collection and control implementation.
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud or other regulated or isolated environments.
  • A security certification or equivalent depth, such as AWS Certified Security - Specialty, CompTIA Security+, or CCSP, or experience with SIEM, intrusion detection, or threat modeling.
  • Experience running AI/LLM infrastructure, such as Amazon Bedrock, LLM gateways, vector databases, or MCP servers.
  • Experience governing AI agent access to cloud environments, including scoped IAM roles, session logging, and approval workflows.
  • Familiarity with GitOps tooling for Terraform and CI/CD platforms such as CircleCI, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodeBuild.
  • Experience with data warehouses and pipelines (for example, Redshift and ETL tooling).
  • Kubernetes/EKS experience.
  • Experience at a small or early-stage company where you wore many hats.

 

Interviews will be recorded and transcribed by an AI notetaking tool so our team can focus on the conversation and review it accurately later. Notes are used only for evaluating your application. You can opt out at any time by letting your recruiter know.

Headquarters: United States, Remote

ROLE: Business Systems Administrator

Location: United States, Remote

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY: 

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY

At Salesloft, our Business Systems Administrator, Customer Experience is critical to our company’s success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing Business Systems team and will lead generating, scoping, solutioning, and executing process and efficiency improvement efforts across customer-focused systems. You will have a passionate, capable team supporting you.  

You will be responsible for the support, development, and maintenance of Salesforce and its related Customer Experience systems. You must own the pursuit of a world-class technology experience for our customers, while enabling scale and efficiency for internal customer experience teams - Support, Services, and Success. You need to have pride in the work you do and a passion for customer support and success. 

On a day to day basis, you will: 

  • Work with Services, Success, and Support teams to identify manual process that can be automated
  • Scope, Plan, Recommend, and Deliver system solutions that help these teams meet their Objectives and Key Results
  • Play a leading role in the exploration, design, build, delivery, and support of a redesigned and improved Customer Hub

This role lives at the heart of how we Make Your Mark: you'll treat systems administration as a discipline — automating, documenting, and fixing root causes so the same issues don't recur. And in the spirit of how we are Customer Inspired — where every decision has a true north, and it's our customer — you'll administer access and configuration as the security controls they are, protecting the company and the data customers trust us with.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are seeking a Salesforce CRM, and related customer experience systems, expert. Someone that can see the big picture, future state but has a keen eye for details. You will have a knack for spotting opportunities to improve systems and process, and are excited to work cross-functionally to make it happen. You are passionate to build relationships to help others succeed.

If you’re looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming a Business Systems Administrator is the career path for you!

THE TEAM

Our Salesloft’s Revenue Operations team is comprised of seasoned and up-and-coming operational experts.

Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired.

The Revenue Operations team consists of team members that work with Sales, Marketing, Customer Services, Finance, and IT to create systems to more efficiently prospect, forecast, close, onboard, and support customers. Team members conceptualize the strategic priorities for the company, develop execution plans, execute plans cross-functionally, and operationalize executed strategies for continuous improvement. 

THE SKILL SET

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 3+ years experience in a related role, Software (SaaS) experience is a plus
  • 2-3 years experience administering Salesforce Service Cloud, Salesforce Knowledge, Live Agent, and Customer Communities preferred
  • Salesforce Administrator certification is required

  • Demonstrated experience designing, revising and managing Salesforce Flows
  • Ability to lead teams through change management and business transformations
  • Excellent project management skills and the ability to collaborate with management and others in the company

title: Principal Data Engineer
description: Headquarters: Remote-US ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen fast.   We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on  Principal Data Engineer to define and evolve the architecture, engineering standards, and operating model for our enterprise data platform. This role is for a technical leader who excels at complex system design: translating business and analytical needs into scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable data products. The Principal Data Engineer will lead critical architectural decisions across data ingestion, storage, transformation, orchestration, governance, observability, and consumption, while raising the engineering bar through mentorship, design reviews, and pragmatic best practices. You will work across engineering, analytics, platform, security, and business stakeholders to create systems that make trusted data accessible, timely, and actionable at scale.   What You’ll Do Lead Data Architecture and System Design Own the technical vision and architecture for scalable, resilient, and cost-effective data platforms and pipelines. Design end-to-end data systems spanning batch and streaming ingestion, transformation, data modeling, storage, orchestration, serving layers, and consumption patterns. Make and document high-quality architecture decisions, including tradeoffs involving performance, reliability, scalability, latency, security, maintainability, and cost. Define reusable architectural patterns for common data engineering challenges, including CDC, event-driven data flows, schema evolution, slowly changing dimensions, data quality, and multi-tenant or domain-oriented data models. Establish clear boundaries and interfaces between operational systems, data platforms, analytics layers, and downstream applications. Lead technical design reviews for high-impact initiatives and provide clear, constructive direction on implementation approaches. Identify architectural risks early and drive plans to mitigate technical debt, single points of failure, data inconsistency, and operational fragility. Set Engineering Standards and Best Practices Establish and continuously improve standards for data engineering development, testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, incident response, and lifecycle management. Define best practices for version-controlled data transformations, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, code review, automated testing, and environment promotion. Build a culture of data reliability by implementing standards for data contracts, schema management, lineage, observability, freshness, completeness, accuracy, and reconciliation. Champion security, privacy, access control, governance, retention, and compliance requirements throughout the data lifecycle. Develop practical engineering guardrails that enable teams to move quickly without sacrificing quality, trust, or operational excellence. Drive adoption of well-defined SLIs, SLOs, alerting, runbooks, and post-incident learning practices for critical data products. Drive Technical Decision-Making Serve as a trusted technical authority for complex, cross-functional decisions involving data architecture, tooling, platform capabilities, and engineering investments. Facilitate technical discussions that turn ambiguous requirements into durable, well-reasoned solutions. Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, platform technologies, and vendor capabilities using clear criteria and documented recommendations. Align architecture decisions with organizational priorities, business outcomes, data strategy, and long-term platform sustainability. Create and maintain architecture decision records, reference architectures, roadmaps, and technical standards that provide clarity across teams. Influence leaders and stakeholders through concise communication of technical options, risks, tradeoffs, and recommended paths forward. Build and Improve Data Products Lead the design and development of high-value, production-grade data pipelines, datasets, and platform capabilities. Partner with data analysts, data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to deliver well-modeled, discoverable, and trustworthy data products. Optimize data systems for reliability, usability, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency. Drive modernization initiatives, including migration from legacy platforms, consolidation of fragmented pipelines, and reduction of manual operational processes. Ensure data products are designed with clear ownership, documentation, lineage, quality expectations, and support models. Mentor and Multiply Engineering Excellence Mentor data engineers at all levels, with a particular focus on growing senior engineers into strong technical leaders. Provide practical coaching on system design, data modeling, debugging, performance tuning, code quality, and production operations. Lead architecture reviews, technical workshops, design sessions, and knowledge-sharing forums. Establish reusable templates, reference implementations, and playbooks that improve consistency and accelerate delivery. Foster an inclusive, high-accountability engineering culture centered on thoughtful collaboration, continuous learning, and ownership. Act as a technical multiplier: helping teams make better decisions independently while maintaining alignment with shared architectural principles.   What you bring Required 10+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, platform engineering, or a related technical discipline. 5+ years designing and operating large-scale data platforms, distributed data systems, or enterprise-grade data products. Demonstrated expertise in end-to-end system design, including defining requirements, evaluating tradeoffs, designing resilient architectures, and delivering production systems. Deep experience with modern data architecture concepts, such as lakehouse or warehouse platforms, batch and streaming processing, data modeling, orchestration, metadata management, and data governance. Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one general-purpose programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or similar. Experience with distributed data processing frameworks and technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, or equivalent platforms. Strong knowledge of data modeling practices across analytical, operational, and domain-oriented use cases. Experience establishing engineering standards for testing, CI/CD, observability, infrastructure as code, reliability, and security. Proven ability to lead technical decisions across multiple teams without relying on direct authority. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers and raising technical standards across an organization. Preferred Experience with cloud-native data platforms on AWS, Azure, or GCP. Experience implementing data mesh, domain-oriented data product, or self-service platform patterns. Familiarity with data governance, cataloging, lineage, privacy, and access-control tooling. Experience supporting financial, revenue, operational, customer, or enterprise analytics domains. Experience with ML data pipelines, feature stores, or AI/LLM data foundations. Experience managing major data-platform migrations, modernization programs, or large-scale architectural transformations. Leadership Competencies Systems thinker : Connects individual technical decisions to broader platform, organizational, and business outcomes. Pragmatic architect : Balances ideal-state architecture with incremental delivery and operational realities. Technical judgment : Makes clear recommendations amid ambiguity and communicates tradeoffs transparently. Builder and operator : Designs for production from the beginning, including reliability, security, observability, and supportability. Mentor and multiplier : Develops others and creates scalable mechanisms for technical excellence. Collaborative influencer : Builds alignment across engineering, analytics, security, product, and business teams.
